title: Documentary pictures cannot bypass P07 through failed best-artifact export
steps: Run the deterministic production export and write boundary regressions with rejected and valid frozen inputs.
expect: Generated documentary frames, their twins, settings and alts never enter the write package.
Unknown provenance refuses; authentic photos and legitimate generic illustrations remain available.
fence: Preserve frozen research and plan inputs; refuse unsupported content before uploads or CMS writes.

tests: a rejected documentary drawn and its twin never enter the exported mapping, upload or alt list
a generic illustrative picture still exports with its original plan and brief
